title: Meet Teacher Dom
lead_en: On December 15 you will interview Teacher Dom, show her Huatan, and visit your clubs together. Get ready here first.
lead_zh: 12 月 15 日，你們要採訪 Dom 老師、帶她認識花壇、一起參觀社團。先在這裡準備好！

bio.en: Dom Jones comes from California, in the United States.
bio.zh: Dom Jones 來自美國加州。

bio.en: She was born in Compton, California. Her mother raised thirteen children, and the family often did not have enough money.
bio.zh: 她在加州的 Compton 出生。她的媽媽養大了十三個孩子，家裡常常不夠用。

bio.en: She did not give up. She went to college and studied communication and women's studies.
bio.zh: 她沒有放棄。她上了大學，念傳播學和婦女研究。

bio.en: For almost 20 years, she has helped people stay healthy through fitness and yoga.
bio.zh: 將近二十年來，她透過健身和瑜伽幫助大家保持健康。

bio.en: She learned Vietnamese and Tagalog to connect with different communities in America.
bio.zh: 為了和美國不同的族群交流，她學了越南語和菲律賓的他加祿語。

bio.en: In 2022, she raced around the world on the TV show The Amazing Race.
bio.zh: 2022 年，她參加了電視節目《極速前進》，跑遍全世界。

bio.en: In 2024, a United Nations group in the USA named her a Young Leader of America.
bio.zh: 2024 年，美國的聯合國協會頒給她「美國青年領袖」的榮譽。

bio.en: Now she lives in Taiwan. Since December 2025, she has visited schools across Taiwan to talk about the SDGs.
bio.zh: 現在她住在台灣。從 2025 年 12 月起，她走訪台灣各地的學校，和學生談聯合國永續發展目標。

bio.en: Her wish is for every young person to know that their voice matters.
bio.zh: 她希望每一個年輕人都知道：你的聲音很重要。

items.en: What was it like growing up in Compton?
items.zh: 在 Compton 長大是什麼感覺？

items.en: Who inspired you when you were young?
items.zh: 你小時候，是誰給了你力量？

items.en: Why did you study communication and women's studies?
items.zh: 你為什麼念傳播學和婦女研究？

items.en: How did you learn Vietnamese and Tagalog?
items.zh: 你是怎麼學會越南語和他加祿語的？

items.en: What was the hardest part of The Amazing Race?
items.zh: 參加《極速前進》最難的是什麼？

items.en: Why did you choose to live in Taiwan?
items.zh: 你為什麼選擇住在台灣？

items.en: What is your favorite Taiwanese food?
items.zh: 你最喜歡的台灣食物是什麼？

items.en: What surprised you most about Taiwanese students?
items.zh: 台灣學生最讓你驚訝的是什麼？

items.en: Which SDG is the most important to you, and why?
items.zh: 哪一個 SDG 對你最重要？為什麼？

items.en: Why do you make cartoons about the SDGs?
items.zh: 你為什麼要做 SDGs 的動畫？

items.en: What can junior high students do for the SDGs?
items.zh: 國中生可以為 SDGs 做什麼？

items.en: What is your favorite English word?
items.zh: 你最喜歡的英文單字是什麼？

items.en: What advice would you give your 14-year-old self?
items.zh: 你會給 14 歲的自己什麼建議？

followups.zh: 你說的 ______ 是什麼意思？

followups.en: How did you feel at that moment?
Thank you for sharing your story.

huatan.en: Huatan is famous for jasmine flowers.
Would you like to try it?

tips.en: Look at Dom and smile when you ask.
tips.zh: 問問題時看著 Dom，面帶微笑。

tips.en: Speak slowly and clearly. It is OK to be nervous!
tips.zh: 說慢一點、清楚一點。緊張也沒關係！

tips.en: Listen to her answer — then ask one follow-up question.
tips.zh: 認真聽她的回答，再接著問一個追問。

tips.en: If you don't understand, say: “Could you say that again, please?”
tips.zh: 聽不懂的時候就說：「可以請你再說一次嗎？」

tips.en: Take turns. Every member of the team asks at least one question.
tips.zh: 輪流問。小組每個人至少問一題。

think.prompt_en: Which question do YOU most want to ask Dom? Practice saying it out loud.
think.prompt_zh: 你最想問 Dom 哪一個問題？大聲練習說幾遍。
think.sentence_zh: 我想問 Dom 的問題是：______
